gigo-lobster-taster 1.1.1

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md (and README.md) for clarity and guidance.
- No code or feature changes; all updates are limited to doc files.

- Improved robustness and reliability of the tasting evaluation flow.
- Enhanced error handling in scoring and task fetching scripts.
- Updated documentation for clearer instructions and troubleshooting.
- Refined logic for handling dependencies and report generation.
- General code cleanup and minor bug fixes.

- Updated skill to support any one of: python3, python, or py executables (previously required python3 or python specifically)
- Added fallback: Generates SVG certificate (`lobster-cert.svg`) if PNG dependencies are missing or can't be installed; `--require-png-cert` forces PNG or fails early
- Improved startup checks and messages for missing pip/venv/ensurepip, and clarified preflight/doctor guidance
- Default run flow is now fully non-interactive; prompts/options can be enabled with `--interactive`
- Now caches remote encrypted task bundle only for the current run, unless `--keep-task-cache` is specified
- Updated docs and triggers: recommend `openclaw skills install/check` and document all CLI and environment overrides
1.0.2: hardened runtime bootstrap, added doctor checks, improved non-interactive host defaults, and fixed register-only/share consistency.
1.0.1: refined leaderboard details, added English fallback tasks, and moved ref_code generation to the server.

龙虾试吃官 1.0.0

- 首个可用版本上线
- 支持本地生成 HTML 试吃报告和 PNG 鉴定证书
- 支持中文与英文触发词
- 支持从 SOUL.md 自动提取龙虾名字与人格标签，也支持手动命名
- 支持七维雷达评分、段位定级和专属鉴定标签
- 支持结果分享页、扫码落地页和本地完整报告解锁链路
- 云端题包已接入短时会话机制，用户无需手动配置题包解密密钥

Lobster Taster 1.0.0

- First usable public release
- Generates a local HTML tasting report and PNG evaluation certificate
- Supports both Chinese and English trigger phrases
- Can read the lobster name and personality tags from SOUL.md, with manual naming supported as well
- Includes seven-dimension radar scoring, tier ranking, and signature evaluation tags
- Supports share pages, QR landing pages, and local full-report unlock flow
- Cloud task delivery now uses short-lived sessions, so users no longer need to configure a bundle decryption key manually
